I've put the proposal in front of you, but please check the year before you accept it. A start date of 2040-01-09 08:00 would push project completion out by more than eleven years.

**What the proposal would do:**
- It adds a start-on-or-after constraint of 2040-01-09 08:00 to #P07-A002-SIG-0190 (Erect cable troughing, section 2). At the moment it has no constraint.
- 2,257 activities would move.
- Project finish would go from 2029-06-22 17:00 to 2040-10-11 17:00, which is **+2,927 days**. That applies to both #MS-P07 and #MS-COMPLETE.

**Why the date looks wrong:** In this update the activity is planned to start on 2028-09-15 08:00 and finish on 2028-09-28 17:00. The whole project currently finishes in 2029. A 2040 date doesn't fit anything else in the schedule. If you meant 2028 or 2029, reject this one and I'll propose the corrected date.

**Background on this activity:**
- It's already 60 days behind: total float is -60 days, down from 0 in the previous update.
- Since the last update it has finished +37 days later, and its original duration went from 1 day to 10.
- It follows #P07-A002-SIG-0160 (Pour ballast, section 2), finish-to-start with a 2-day lag.
- It drives #P07-A002-SIG-0200 and #P07-A002-SIG-0220.

Any constraint that holds this activity later will add straight onto that negative float. If it would help, I can trace what is behind its slip before you settle on a date.
